1. DoD results. (a) native store: PARTIAL. 57 tests, 48 pass, 9 fail (before 13/44); zero GES-LOCK strings remain; all 13 previously passing tests still pass; the 9 reds all failed before, none is new. Causes: 5x EPERM on symlink creation (windows symlink privilege; tests :530, :814, :897, :1012, :1320); :1100 GES-RESTRICTED-WINDOWS-ASSURANCE (store.mjs:232, DACL assurance insecure on the real temp dir; unverified); :1247 GES-RESTRICTED-PERMISSIONS (store.mjs:226, POSIX mode check on a win32 host); :1307 and :1332 GES-EXISTING-REPOSITORY-BINDING (store.mjs:891/930, cause NOT diagnosed). (b) native ceremony: FAILED against the 5/5 target: 5 tests, 4 pass, 1 fail. End-to-end is green. The drift case (signing-ceremony.test.mjs:328, assertion :349) fails with Missing expected rejection: install succeeded after an unrelated commit landed. That is not a lock error; GMW-CANDIDATE-COMMIT-MISMATCH is raised at lib/guard-maintenance-window.mjs:1509-1511 only if intervenedCommitsStayWithinScope (:1504) returns false, and on win32 it apparently did not (cause undiagnosed; file belongs to WIN-GES-F3, untouched). It was masked by GES-LOCKED before. WSL before and after: PASSED, 93/93 both, exit 0, no red absent from before. check-consumer-safe-paths: PASSED 9/9 exit 0. Commit: PASSED, 95452767f, exact subject, trailers Dispatch + AI-Assisted only.

2. Evidence (repo-relative): evidence/WIN-GES-F2-20261009/{wsl-before,native-store-after,native-ceremony-after,wsl-after}.txt via capture-evidence.mjs (exit codes 0,1,1,0); node --test harness/scripts/check-consumer-safe-paths.test.mjs exit 0.

3. Changed files: plugins/pipeline-core/lib/governance-event-store.mjs (+37/-7): guard path via env GES_STREAM_LOCK_GUARD_PATH with constant script; try/catch maps HResult low word 32/33 to exit 75 and anything else to stderr + exit 2; readiness /ready\r?\n/; stderr piped, drained, bounded to 2048 chars; close instead of exit; GES-LOCKED only when exit equals the command's held code (1 for perl default, 75 win32), else GES-LOCK-RUNTIME with exit code, signal and stderr head.

4. Deliberately not changed: tests; guard-maintenance-window.mjs; perl branch; the 9 reds; the other slices' untracked records; the evidence artifacts and this record stay untracked.

5. Deviations: reused existing GES-LOCK-RUNTIME as the distinct code (nothing in plugins/ or harness/ matches it; only tests match GES-LOCKED) instead of minting a new name. Held exit on win32 is 75, not 1, so a PowerShell parse error (exit 1) can never read as contention again. The briefing says the guard holds the lock while the store writes; in the code it is held only while .lock is inspected or created (acquireStreamLock finally releases), unchanged by this commit. NOT separately verified: a contended win32 guard (sharing violation to exit 75); the racing-writer and live-lock tests pass natively but may have lost at the .lock check rather than the guard. 3 tool uses lost to guard refusals (directory read targets, rg flags).

6. Open items: drift case red (hand to WIN-GES-F3 or a follow-up, with the undiagnosed intervenedCommitsStayWithinScope behaviour on win32); the 9 non-lock native reds; independent Critic review pending; PO acceptance pending. Not a closing-allowance handover.
